title: Bach — Little Prelude in C, BWV 939

reference.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (Mutopia 2008/11/06-1593, Hajo Dezelski after Bach-Gesellschaft Band 36 / Ernst Naumann 1890). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: 4/4, C major, 16 bars, no repeats. The shortest real piece here after the Czerny exercise.

Six printed \mordent signs at 2 added notes each: expectedExtraNotes 12. Dense ornaments over very few notes make this the sharpest check that the ornament allowance is derived from the page rather than fitted.
No printed metronome mark and no \midi tempo directive, so expectedTempo is a wide band and tempoInRange is a diagnostic only.
